DataSource.query:
SELECT
DISTINCT 
'Neue_Kostenstellen',
a.kostenstelle
FROM
DTL_KST_BELEGE a
WHERE
a.geschaeftsjahr>= '2025'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT 'Neue_Kostenstellen', b.org_schl  FROM dtl_kst_plandaten b 
WHERE b.wert <> 0 AND ((b.geschaeftsjahr >= '2023' AND b.version = 0) OR (b.version = 1 AND b.geschaeftsjahr = '2024') OR (b.version = 1 AND b.geschaeftsjahr = '2025')) 

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT 'Neue_Kostenstellen', c.kostenstelle FROM dtl_kst_meldedaten_neu c WHERE c.wert <> 0 and to_date(c.monatsscheibe, 'Mon_YY') >= '01-Jan-2025'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT 'Neue_Kostenstellen', d.kostenstelle FROM dtl_kst_meldedaten_plan d WHERE d.wert <> 0 and to_date(d.monatsscheibe, 'Mon_YY') >= '01-Jan-2025'

order by 2 ASC
